purpose: Provide a research-only anytime-valid stopping/decision sensitivity bound for the five highest-priority Dragonflight prospecting source-conflict mappings, conditional on full independently reviewed output universe, finite verified per-cast output caps, fixed price snapshot, homogeneous IID completed casts and exact profession context. No numerical Retail P/E inferred.
context: Uses existing strict Dragonflight prospecting validateContext; requires full output IDs/quality ranks, recipe, skill, stats, patch, epoch, lineage, nominal reagents and caller-attested complete universe. Separate completed/aborted casts and refunds.

methods.descriptive: For each output j: observed P_j = completed casts with count_j>0 / completed casts; observed unconditional E_j = sum count_j including zeros / completed casts. Never multiply E by P.
methods.range: If each output has independently supported maxPerCast cap B_j, margin lies in [ -nominalInput*inputPrice-deposit, sum_j(B_j*outputPrice_j*(1-cut))-deposit ]. No assumption of independent co-outputs.
methods.confidenceSequence: For n completed IID casts with fixed bounded range [L,U], alpha_n=alpha/(n(n+1)); two-sided Hoeffding radius (U-L)*sqrt(log(2*n*(n+1)/alpha)/(2*n)); clip sampleMean±radius to [L,U]. Sum alpha_n over all n equals alpha. Valid at arbitrary optional stopping times under assumptions.
methods.decisions: Only descriptive conditional signs when interval wholly positive or negative. No actual liquidation recommendation, confidence promotion or live EV.

applicability.caps: Caller claims INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED, independent source lineage, exact output ranks, complete universe. Code cannot authenticate provenance; validator must independently verify before interpreting bound.
applicability.price: Fixed timestamped price vector, all output prices, input price, AH cut and deposit. Not fetched from live TSM/AH.
applicability.iid: Independent identically distributed completed casts within fixed patch/build, rank, skill, specialization, gear, unlocks, Resourcefulness profile. No cross-epoch pooling.
applicability.unbounded: If no verified cap/universe or fixed prices, return descriptive E/P and null statistical margin interval; no fabricated finite bound.
